newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telebras firms in quiet session.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telebras firms in quiet session.

text.p: Telecomunicacoes Brasileiras SA, or Telebras, American Depositary Receipts firmed in U.S. trade on Monday in an otherwise quiet session ahead of this week's New Year holiday.
Telebras added 3/4 to 77-1/8 in early afternoon New York Stock Exchange trade, easing off a peak of 77-3/8 earlier in the day.

"The markets are real quiet, though there are buyers in the Brazilian telecoms and electric sector. People realize that is still the chaepest market, trading at significant discount to its peers," a trader said.
Supporting the Telebras rise was the company's announcement of unaudited, 11-month financial results showing earnings per American Depositary Share of $7.34.
Also, Bear Stearns reiterated its strong buy recommendation of the company and said it "believes Telebras is on a trajectory to meet our $8 per ADS full-year 1996 earnings forecast."
